limits: One XY sketch plane from an empty document: one ellipse (centre (10, 5), clicks on the 1 mm grid), edited by the panel (Angle, Ry, Rx), extruded 10 mm.
Canvas clicks are real mouse events at pixels from window.__studioScreenOf.
The too-narrow edit (Ry 5 with Rx 60) is refused; the panel field returns to its current value by itself (no Escape key is pressed: Escape would leave the sketch).
Undo / Redo use the toolbar buttons when enabled, else Meta+z / Meta+Shift+z; which state one Undo returns to is recorded.
Product reads (the bundled inspector) are product code, not an independent oracle.
The Python oracle (python3 -I, zero product imports) decides point exactness, outline deviation, area, volume, side ids and the exact NURBS curve.
Hashes are source provenance, not geometry oracles.
